US.name: United States
US.description: 2×2 inch (51×51 mm) square photo with white or off-white background
requirementsBulletPoints: Plain white or off-white background — no patterns, textures, or shadows
Neutral facial expression with mouth closed; eyes open and looking directly at the camera
No eyeglasses (required since November 2016); no tinted lenses
No hats or head coverings unless worn daily for religious reasons, with a signed statement
Photo must have been taken within the last 6 months
Face must occupy 50–69% of the photo height in the 2×2 inch frame

UK.name: United Kingdom
UK.description: 35×45 mm photo with light grey or cream plain background
requirementsBulletPoints: Plain light grey or cream background — no patterns or shadows behind the head
Neutral expression with mouth closed; both eyes open and clearly visible
No tinted glasses; plain prescription glasses only if essential, with no reflections or tinted lenses
Head coverings only for religious or medical reasons and must not obscure facial features
Photo taken within the last month and printed in colour
Face must fill 65–75% of the frame height from chin to crown

India.name: India
India.description: 51×51 mm (2×2 inch) square photo with plain white background
requirementsBulletPoints: Plain white background — no patterns, designs, or shadows
Neutral expression; mouth closed; looking directly at the camera
No spectacles — glasses of any type are not permitted as of recent guidelines
No head coverings unless worn for religious reasons; full face must remain clearly visible
Photo must be recent, taken within the last 6 months
Face and forehead must be clearly visible occupying 70–80% of the frame height

Canada.name: Canada
Canada.description: 50×70 mm photo with plain white background
requirementsBulletPoints: Plain white or off-white background with no shadows, objects, or patterns
Neutral expression with mouth closed; eyes open, clearly visible, and looking directly at the camera
No glasses of any kind (required since February 2022)
No head coverings unless worn for religious reasons; a signed declaration is required
Photo must have been taken within the last 6 months and be printed in colour
Head (from chin to crown) must measure 31–36 mm and be centred in the 50×70 mm frame

Australia.name: Australia
Australia.description: 35×45 mm photo with plain white or off-white background
requirementsBulletPoints: Plain white or light grey background — no shadows, patterns, or objects
Neutral expression with mouth closed; both eyes fully open and looking directly at the camera
No sunglasses; clear prescription glasses permitted only if no reflections or tinting obscure the eyes
No hats or head coverings except for religious or medical reasons; full face must be unobscured
Photo must be taken within the last 6 months and printed in natural colour
Head height (chin to crown) should occupy 71–80% of the photo height

UAE.name: United Arab Emirates
UAE.description: 40×60 mm photo with plain white background
UAE.source: General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs
requirementsBulletPoints: Plain white background — no shadows, gradients, or patterns
Neutral expression with mouth closed; both eyes open and clearly looking at the camera
No sunglasses or tinted lenses; clear glasses may be accepted if no glare obscures the eyes
Traditional headdress (e.g. hijab, kandura) is acceptable provided the face is fully visible from forehead to chin
Photo must be taken within the last 6 months
Face should occupy 70–80% of the photo height; no shadows on face or background

Schengen.name: Schengen (EU)
Schengen.description: 35×45 mm photo with plain light grey background (ICAO standard)
requirementsBulletPoints: Plain light grey background — uniform colour, no patterns, shadows, or objects
Neutral expression with mouth closed; eyes open and looking directly at the camera
No glasses of any kind (ICAO Doc 9303 standard, adopted by Schengen countries)
No head coverings unless worn for established religious practice; face must be fully visible
Photo taken within the last 6 months and printed in colour at 300 DPI minimum
Face height (eyes to chin) must occupy at least 70% of the total photo height per ICAO biometric standards

Germany.name: Germany
Germany.description: 35×45 mm photo with plain light grey background per Bundesdruckerei biometric standards
requirementsBulletPoints: Plain light grey background — no patterns, shadows, or coloured surfaces
Neutral expression with mouth closed; eyes open, looking directly at the camera
No glasses — prohibited since 2017 under German biometric passport rules
No hats or head coverings except for documented religious or medical reasons; full face must be visible
Photo must be recent (taken within the last 6 months) and printed in colour
Face must occupy 65–75% of the frame height; head must be centred with no tilt

France.name: France
France.description: 35×45 mm photo with plain white background per ANTS/service-public.fr standards
requirementsBulletPoints: Plain white or very light grey background — no shadows, patterns, or objects
Neutral expression with mouth closed; both eyes open, clearly visible, and looking at the camera
No glasses of any kind (prohibited since biometric rules took effect)
No head coverings except for religious reasons with a signed statement; full face clearly visible
Photo taken within the last 6 months by a professional photographer or approved booth
Face must be centred and occupy 65–75% of the photo height; no hair covering the eyes

Japan.name: Japan
Japan.description: 45×35 mm landscape photo (width x height) with plain white background per Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
Japan.source: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
requirementsBulletPoints: Plain white background — uniform, no shadows or patterns
Neutral expression with mouth closed; both eyes open and looking directly at the camera
No sunglasses or tinted lenses; clear prescription glasses may be accepted without glare
No hats, caps, or head coverings except for religious or medical reasons
Photo taken within the last 6 months and printed in natural colour
Face (from top of head to chin) must occupy 65–80% of the photo height in the 45x35 mm landscape frame

China.name: China
China.description: 33×48 mm photo with plain white background per National Immigration Administration of China
China.source: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China (NIA site is China-only; consult your nearest Chinese consulate)
requirementsBulletPoints: Plain white background — no patterns, shadows, or other colours
Neutral expression with mouth closed; both eyes fully open and looking directly at the camera
No glasses (prohibited under current Chinese passport photo regulations)
No head coverings unless worn for established religious practice; entire face must be clearly visible
Photo must be recent (taken within the last 6 months) and printed in colour
Face height should occupy 65–75% of the 33×48 mm photo frame with even lighting and no shadows on the face

Brazil.name: Brazil
Brazil.description: 50×70 mm photo with plain white background per Policia Federal do Brasil standards
requirementsBulletPoints: Plain white background — no shadows, gradients, or patterns
Neutral expression with mouth closed; both eyes open and looking directly at the camera
No sunglasses or tinted glasses; clear prescription glasses must have no tint or reflective glare
No hats or head coverings except for religious reasons; full face clearly visible from chin to forehead
Photo taken within the last 6 months and printed in colour on glossy paper
Head (chin to crown) must be centred in the 50×70 mm frame with proportions matching biometric standards

NewZealand.name: New Zealand
NewZealand.description: 35×45 mm photo with plain white or light grey background per New Zealand Department of Internal Affairs
NewZealand.source: New Zealand Department of Internal Affairs
requirementsBulletPoints: Plain white or very light grey background — uniform, no patterns or shadows
Neutral expression with mouth closed; both eyes open and looking directly at the camera
No sunglasses or tinted glasses; clear prescription glasses must have no reflections or tinting
No hats or head coverings unless worn for religious or medical reasons; full face must be clearly visible
Photo taken within the last 6 months and printed in natural colour
Face should occupy 65–75% of the photo height; head must be upright and centred in the frame

Singapore.name: Singapore
Singapore.description: 35×45 mm photo with plain white background per Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) Singapore
requirementsBulletPoints: Plain white background — no shadows, patterns, or other colours
Neutral expression with mouth closed; both eyes fully open and looking directly at the camera
No sunglasses or tinted lenses; clear glasses are permitted if no reflections or tinting obscure the eyes
Head coverings only for religious reasons; full face from forehead to chin must be clearly visible
Photo taken within the last 3 months and printed in colour
Face must occupy 65–75% of the frame height; no hair or accessories covering the eyes or face outline

Mexico.name: Mexico
Mexico.description: 35×45 mm photo with plain white background per Secretaria de Relaciones Exteriores (SRE) Mexico
requirementsBulletPoints: Plain white background — no shadows, patterns, or coloured surfaces
Neutral expression with mouth closed; both eyes open and looking directly at the camera
No sunglasses or tinted lenses; clear prescription glasses may be worn if there is no glare
No hats or head coverings except for religious or medical reasons; full face must be visible
Photo taken within the last 6 months and printed in colour
Face must occupy 65–75% of the frame height; head should be centred and upright with no tilt
